findingInterpretation: No concrete P1/P2 defect confirmed within these focused synthetic cases and static integration review. This is not an exhaustive safety proof.
focusedCoverage: New service/document evidence passes common classification guards, receives content evidence, retains own label/action/href/target and produces matching actual rendered cards.
Actual service locate card gives focus without original click, JavaScript action, download or form submit activation.
Document command mutation immediately before actual card click rejects stale source before locate/focus.
Service peer checkout command introduced by source focus produces changed result/no highlight/no source activation.
Document equal-content header child replacement during source focus produces changed result/no highlight/no source activation.
Same-content service title/peer and document header/row/wrapper clones invalidate old integrated source identity.

Poisoned input.value/checked/textContent/innerText and editor child nodeValue remain unread across analyze/classify/currentness/UI/locate; private strings absent from safe diagnostics and cards; nested private service control gains no relation.
Whole forms, role=form, external form ownership and default-submit controls do not gain new service relations; moving the source card into a form invalidates it.
Dangerous peer title/own script/own command-query and interactive table-header role cannot revive new relation classification.
Successive areCandidatesCurrent calls create fresh institution/content batches: equal-title node replacement and then interactive ARIA insertion are noticed in the same browser task.

preservedIntermediateFailure.adjudication: Harness mistake only: the original notice is in its host shadowRoot; reading host.textContent returned empty while the preserved assertion context showed the changed alert. Corrected to shadowRoot paragraph plus data-easyweb-notice-reason=changed. Product source unchanged. Private nested fixture and form-move fixture were also strengthened before the final passing run.

staticConclusions: Classification applies common command/script URL and label checks before calling new semantic relations.
Currentness independently recomputes new relation evidence before content evidence and compares actual dependency element references plus fingerprints.

Service/document modules retain no DOM result cache; institution/content/navigation caches are constructed anew per classify/areCandidatesCurrent call. Standalone later isCandidateCurrent calls receive no retained default cache.
Actual UI uses per-card currentness guards and action-bridge rechecks currentness after focus; source links/buttons are not programmatically clicked by these paths.
limits: 10 focused synthetic integrated cases only; variants inside cases are not extra test-count claims.
No full verify, quality comparison, pipeline benchmark, live public task, native install, VoiceOver, actual browser zoom or human study run by this reviewer.
Reviewed existing 60-page development exposure context only; new service/document relations are development improvements to exposed v10 misses, not fresh independent quality evidence.
Original v0.9 source/freeze/evaluation/firstFAIL/archives remain outside reviewer write scope.
